question:
Select the Venn diagram that best illustrates the relationship among the following classes.

Tennis fans, Students, Hockey players
solution:
**Least Possible Venn Diagram: **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e926a97ca45b8b083a35d843aa4c4719b4cb530745aaaea9bb46621c90caa185.png]
